prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. One complete existing DooKnow LOCAL component on neutral light-gray backdrop, not a full invented host page. Simplified Chinese, crisp natural-size controls, flat white/#f7f8fa, dark #272b3a/secondary#657084, thin #e6e9f1 lines, primary#4566c6,8px radii and restrained shadow. PILOT input is STYLE ONLY, no importing its rail/header/tree/content. Actual source templates determine all titles, field order, controls, permissions and selected state. No protocol requestId/version/hash/cursor/CSRF fields, fabricated success/online states, team/AI/ToDoo features or OS/browser-dialog chrome. Secret data empty or masked only. One coherent selected condition; hidden alternatives remain hidden. Preserve header/close/body-scroll/footer actions and actual disabled guards; do not derive new disabled rules from API constraints.
SOURCE-DERIVED ENLARGED BLOG HOMEPAGE PREVIEW NATIVE DIALOG. Parent baseline's preview HTML is EMPTY, so preserve that selected initial condition rather than invent a rendered blog homepage. Do not draw the outer studio form, owner rail/site banner, live-preview checkbox or public full-page preview. Large landscape dialog: exact header 主页预览, subtitle 查看当前草稿的访客视角; actual autofocus text button 关闭预览 at right (NO extraX since source dialog has no native closeX).
Toolbar: 桌面 active, 手机 inactive; actual read-only label 1100 px 视口 · 按窗口缩放; 刷新预览 enabled. Source state expanded=true,device=desktop,designPreviewHtml='',previewBusy=false,error absent. Main internal viewport is the fixed1100px desktop region scaled to available window, blank white inside. In its center exact source placeholder 正在准备你的主页。 and existing enabled button 生成预览. Both refresh in toolbar and generate in empty slot are real simultaneous source controls. Bottom note exact 预览仅自己可见。按 Escape 可关闭并返回编辑。 No generated/success/busy spinner/error/private-preview HTML banner or configured site articles in this EMPTY state, no phone preview, no extra editable viewport-size field. Preserve native dialog body scroll/focus/backdrop/Escape contracts; no browser/device chrome. Full local dialog only, readable hierarchy.
